title: fix(metadata-protocol, cli, cloud-connection): a declared action override moved to another object is told which object the base ships the action on
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6Ehjp6oVrWQjMzb1AkDfRk)_

Fixes #30623

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：`.custom` 动作覆盖把 `objectName` 写成了与基包动作不同的对象时，`declared_package_ships_no_such_item` 拒绝信息现在点名两个对象，并告诉作者保留基包动作的 `objectName`；三个入口（保存/发布门、`os validate`、托管安装）用同一句话。
2. 为什么改：#30623。原话说基包「没有叫 X 的动作」、让作者「改名」，可名字是对的、错的是对象，作者会去改错地方。
3. 风险与回滚：只改文案。规则、错误码（`NOT_OVERRIDABLE`）、状态码（403）、判定结果全不变；基包根本没有这个名字时，文案与今天一字不差。回滚即 revert。
4. 先看：`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` 的 `shipsNoSuchItemMessage`（唯一的句子构造器）和 `OverrideWriteClosure.baseItemsOf`（三个入口各自递进基包的同类条目）。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-override-gate.test.ts`，预期 14/14 绿，其中 `[#30623]` 两条（换对象、CONTROL）。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One builder** — `shipsNoSuchItemMessage` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` writes the `declared_package_ships_no_such_item` sentence. `judgeOverrideWrite` already serves all three doors, so the builder lives there, in the lowest package all three already import; no new cross-package export.
- When a declared `action` override names a base that ships an action of that name on **another object**, the sentence becomes: `'action/NAME' declares an override of 'BASE' on object 'OVERRIDE_OBJECT', but 'BASE' ships its action 'NAME' on object 'BASE_OBJECT'. An override replaces the base's action on that action's own object: keep the base action's objectName: 'BASE_OBJECT' in the override, or remove overrides to keep it as 'PAIR''s own item (ADR-0146 D2).`
- Otherwise (another type, a name the base does not ship at all, or no base items in hand) the sentence is today's, byte for byte.
- `OverrideWriteClosure` gains an optional `baseItemsOf(base)`: the base's items of this type at any object. Each door hands it the items it already holds:
  - save/publish door (`overrideWriteVerdict`): the artifact lookup's items under that base's `_packageId`;
  - `os validate` (`packages/cli/src/utils/override-declarations.ts`): the base package's walked items, when the artifact carries it;
  - managed install (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`): the base's listing it already reads (`heldBy`).
- The packageless overlay migration (`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`, `cli migrate packageless-overlays`) only names the code in a comment and asks `overrideWriteVerdict`, so it gets the new sentence with no change.
- The rule, code and status are unchanged. No `packages/spec/**`.

Changed lines: 174 (+165 / -9, 7 files).

## Tests

- Save door: `packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`: `[#30623]` pins the full sentence through `saveMetaItem` (403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) for `showcase_task_close` moved to `showcase_other`, plus a CONTROL for an unshipped name (today's sentence, whole verdict).
- `os validate`: `packages/cli/src/utils/override-declarations.test.ts`: `log_call` (base on `crm_account`) declared on `crm_lead`, first sentence plus the `objectName: 'crm_account'` remedy; CONTROL `no_such_call`.
- Managed install: `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-override-gate.test.ts`: `crm_close` (base on `crm_account`) declared on `crm_lead` → 403, nothing saved or ledgered, first sentence plus remedy; separate CONTROL `crm_reopen`.
